home.title: Admin home
home.headline: Separate admin landing page with a clearer workspace map
home.managerHeadline: Store-scoped control room for daily operations
home.copy: The sample dashboard from the older folder separated overview and management more clearly. This page keeps that structure while reusing the existing CRUD workspace in the current project.
home.managerCopy: Your manager area stays focused on one working store. The admin workspace below is grouped by daily flow so the live tasks are easier to reach.

analytics.title: Operational overview
analytics.subtitle: Activity summary across all stores in the system.
analytics.managerSubtitle: Numbers are locked to your assigned store only.
analytics.bestSellerEmpty: No best seller data yet for the current scope.
analytics.rankedByRevenue: Ranked by paid revenue, then total orders.
analytics.noComments: No review comments yet in the current scope.
analytics.noDataLoaded: No best seller data yet for the current scope.
analytics.latestCommentEmpty: No review comments yet in the current scope.

charts.chartNote: Chart shows max 7 days. Longer ranges show the last 7 days.
charts.storeNote: Max 7 days. Longer ranges show the last 7 days ending at the chosen end date.
charts.noOrdersData: No orders data for the selected date range.
charts.dishesNote: Dishes driving volume in the last 7-day window.
charts.noTopSelling: No top-selling dish data yet for the current analytics scope.

operations.title: Operations and customer care
operations.description: This block groups the modules used most often during live store operations: orders, moderation, and customer support.

network.title: Stores, people, and experiences
network.description: Use this area for branch setup, team assignment, and event management across the network or your assigned store.

catalog.title: Catalog and inventory structure
catalog.description: These tools shape how the menu is structured, stocked, and exposed in each store scope.

growth.title: Content, campaigns, and retention
growth.description: This area follows the sample dashboard structure for editorial content and growth modules, while staying inside the existing admin workspace.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Track payment state, QR scans, invoice flow, and branch fulfillment handoff.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Moderate store, event, and dish reviews from one moderation queue.

feedbacks.title: Feedback
feedbacks.description: Handle support replies, complaints, and follow-up messages from customers.

stores.title: Stores
stores.description: Maintain branch identity, opening hours, address data, and operational scope.

users.title: Users
users.description: Manage admin, manager, staff, shipper, and customer accounts with working store scope.

events.title: Events
events.description: Plan store events, featured dishes, capacity, and calendar visibility.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Organize menu structure by branch so the storefront stays easy to scan.

dishes.title: Core dishes
dishes.description: Maintain the franchise-level catalog, signatures, highlights, and pricing baseline.

storeDishes.title: Store dishes
storeDishes.description: Control branch stock, availability, and local price overrides for each dish.

news.title: News
news.description: Publish brand stories, branch updates, and editorial content for the storefront.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.description: Create offers and time-bound campaigns for conversion and retention.

userLevels.title: User levels
userLevels.description: Set membership tiers and loyalty thresholds used across the customer journey.

workspace.overviewNote: This overview helps you quickly monitor operational scale and overall system data.

reports.title: Order and revenue analytics
reports.subtitleAdmin: Track completed orders, compare store contribution, and review revenue distribution across the network.
reports.subtitleManager: Track completed orders and revenue contribution for your assigned store scope.
reports.emptyText: No completed orders match the selected date range or search query.
reports.summaryNote: Only COMPLETED orders in the date range are counted. Paid pending = paid but not yet completed.

forms.needsReviewNote: Backend still expects manual input for this field.
forms.sectionContentPlaceholder: Describe this section in more detail.
forms.sectionImageNote: One image path per line. The first image is also mirrored into the legacy imagePath field.
forms.imageUploadNote: Upload order is kept in imagePaths[]. The first item becomes the hero image and mirrors into the legacy imagePath alias.

invoice.title: Invoice preview
invoice.previewNote: Preview the invoice directly in this popup. You can click Print invoice or press Ctrl+P.
invoice.noPreviewLink: This invoice does not have a preview link available for printing yet.
invoice.browserBlocked: Your browser blocked direct printing in the popup. Open a new tab and press Ctrl+P.

news.previewDescription: This preview reads directly from the admin news record.

orderDetail.assignShipperUpdateHint: Update the assigned shipper before pickup is confirmed.
orderDetail.assignShipperChooseHint: Choose the assigned shipper, then click Next to move the order to Waiting for shipper.
orderDetail.noShipperAvailable: No shippers are assigned to this store yet.

passwordModal.noStoreAssigned: Not assigned to a specific store
passwordModal.hint: Use this flow to quickly change the password for the selected account. The backend keeps all other user fields unchanged and only updates the new password.

storeAnalytics.title: Revenue, best sellers, and payment flow
storeAnalytics.subtitleAdmin: Choose a store scope to read revenue, payment speed, fulfillment mix, and best seller momentum.
storeAnalytics.subtitleManager: Manager workspace only shows analytics for the assigned store.
storeAnalytics.bestSellersCurrentScope: Best sellers from the current analytics scope
storeAnalytics.topSellingBackendNote: Backend returns this ranking from `topSellingDishes`, sorted by quantity sold first and revenue second.
storeAnalytics.noTopSellingData: No top-selling dish data is available in the current scope yet.

storeAnalytics.fullSystemView: You are viewing the full system. Choose a store if you want to narrow the scope.
storeAnalytics.noBestSellerData: No best seller data is available in the current scope yet.
storeAnalytics.watchPaymentSpeed: Focus on payment speed when average payment time rises unexpectedly.
storeAnalytics.watchBestSeller: Track best seller quantity against revenue to spot low-margin menu items.
storeAnalytics.watchPipeline: Watch pipeline imbalance if delivery stays high while completed orders flatten.
